apparatus.reference_model: Balanced Body Allegro 2 (modern 'contemporary' reformer); classical Gratz/Basi-style machines differ mainly in spring colors, footbar and box dimensions. Numbers are modelling approximations rounded from manufacturer specs; items marked (est.) are estimates, not published specs.

coordinate_system.x_long_axis: 0 at the footbar end of the frame, +x toward the headrest/shoulder-block end
coordinate_system.carriage_displacement_convention: 0 cm = carriage fully closed (against the stopper/springs at the footbar end). Positive = carriage rolled away from the footbar (springs stretched). Mannequin ~170 cm tall, thigh ~43, shin ~43 cm; footwork excursion scales roughly 0.4 x leg length.

frame.rail: two parallel aluminum/wood side rails with rollers; frame is a rectangle, footbar end called 'front'
frame.floor_clearance: carriage top surface ~36-38 cm above floor with legs (est.)

carriage.rest_position: closed at footbar end, pulled in by springs
carriage.stopper: adjustable carriage stopper limits closing; on classical machine carriage rests on felt bumpers

headrest.description: padded, 2-3 height positions (flat 0 deg, raised ~10-12 deg); 25 cm long x ~25 cm wide at the head end of the carriage, hinged
headrest.use: raised for most supine work if neck is not neutral; lowered for long-box, arabesque etc.

shoulder_blocks.description: two padded blocks at the head end of the carriage, ~35-38 cm apart inside edge-to-edge (est.), ~8-10 cm high x 8 cm wide x 20 cm long; they stop the sliding body and are used as hand/foot targets
shoulder_blocks.use: shoulders press into blocks during footwork; feet or knees lodge against them in standing/kneeling work

footbar.description: steel/wood bar (diameter ~3 cm) across the frame at the front, ~55 cm long, mounted on two posts; the Balanced Body Infinity footbar adjusts vertically in 4 positions (including 'down') and slides horizontally to 9 positions; classical footbar has 2-3 heights and hinges down flat

positions.down: bar lies near deck height (~2-5 cm above carriage level) - used for footwork, long stretch, balance control front (est.)

footbar.cautions: bar height plus carriage travel changes hip/knee angles of every footwork exercise

springs.count: 4-5 hooked to the gear (spring) bar at the footbar end and the carriage underside; 3-5 gear bar positions set base tension; pins/hooks along 5 slots

balanced_body_colors.red: medium (default heavy for most work on a standard machine)

springs.standard_set: 3 red + 1 blue + 1 yellow (Allegro 2); some models 3 red, 1 blue, 1 green
springs.classical_note: Gratz-style springs are all similar tension; heavy = 3-4 springs, medium = 2, light = 1
springs.default_footwork: 2 red + 1 blue (3 springs) typical; 'light' = 1 red or 1 blue + 1 red
springs.spring_visual: coil springs, ~40 cm long unloaded, drawn as colored rings along the underside; stretch visibly as carriage rolls out (~1.5x rest length at full travel)

straps_ropes_pulleys.description: two long ropes (~2 m) each ending in a hand loop (padded handle) and a foot loop; ropes run through pulleys at the head end of the frame (per sources) and terminate on the carriage; pulling the straps with the arms or legs rolls the carriage away from the footbar
straps_ropes_pulleys.hook_rest: ropes hang on hooks at the frame; handles stored on the posts
straps_ropes_pulleys.pulley_riser: two upright posts (risers) ~25-35 cm high (est.) that lift the pulleys out of the frame line; used for strap work with straps over the body (leg circles, frog, arm work); without risers the pulleys sit in the frame line
straps_ropes_pulleys.strap_behaviour: strap line from hands/feet goes up and toward the pulley; tension is constant because the rope is attached to the carriage - carriage cannot close until the strap is eased

long_box.dimensions_cm: approx. 80-90 L x 55 W x 18-20 H, padded (est.)
long_box.placement: lies on the carriage lengthwise with its short end against the shoulder rests (head-end), footbar down; used for pulling straps, backstroke, swan, T, rowing variations

short_box.dimensions_cm: approx. 55-60 L x 40-45 W x 20-22 H (BB short box 12 in/30 cm high, 3 height settings) (est.)
short_box.placement: placed crosswise on the carriage behind the shoulder rests, strap attached at footbar end; client sits on it with feet under the footstrap or footbar; used for short box series

jump_board.description: padded 50-55 cm wide board attached at the footbar end, ~40-50 cm high, tilted ~10 deg back from vertical; replaces footbar; used for jumps and plyos
jump_board.use: feet land flat/toe on the board; client lies supine with carriage out/in; light springs (1 blue + 1 red typical) with maximum safe fall of carriage ~0.5 s

apparatus.footstrap_and_sit_box: Short box uses a footstrap (strap with two foot loops on the front of the carriage / on the footbar); also 'sitting box' or half-circle on the carriage for stretches

wunda_chair.pedal: single padded rectangular pedal ~45 cm wide at the front hinged to the chair back; vertical travel ~28-30 cm; some chairs have split pedals (Exo chair)
wunda_chair.springs: two heavy springs, each with 4 attachment positions on the back post (BB cactus system) giving ~8 resistance levels; spring tension set per exercise
wunda_chair.handles: two side handles on posts at the sides of the chair (BB Exo chair) used for push-ups; back straps optional
wunda_chair.notes: chair is used by one body at a time; floor in front = mat space

apparatus.confidence: medium (published specs for frame/carriage/box; footbar and riser heights estimated)

phases.name: press_out
phases.description: Press the carriage away by extending hips and knees evenly; pelvis, ribcage and shoulders stay still on the carriage; knees stay over 2nd toes
contacts: feet on footbar, balls of feet
phases.implement_path: carriage rolls from closed to 35 cm; springs stretch
phases.notes: stop 3-5 degrees short of knee lock; heels stay high/level

phases.name: extended_hold
phases.description: Brief pause with legs long, hip flexors/glutes active, no gripping of toes

phases.name: return
phases.description: Bend hips and knees slowly to bring the carriage back; control spring pull; do not let the carriage clunk
phases.implement_path: carriage closes smoothly 35 -> 0 cm (stop 1-2 cm short of the stopper)
phases.notes: keep pelvis neutral (no posterior tilt at the end)

cues: Move from the hips, not the back
Heels level, knees track over second toe

mistakes.mistake: Pelvis tucks (posterior tilt) as the carriage closes
mistakes.visual: lower back lifts off the pad and knees collapse toward chest
mistakes.fix: stop earlier, use lighter springs or add a heel-height cue
control the return, stop 1-2 cm short of the stopper

specs.safety: Reduce load or range with a back/hip/knee issue; keep neck neutral; avoid knee lock.
specs.regression: Parallel feet at toes with lighter springs; keep neutral pelvis, reduce range.
specs.progression: Heavier/lighter springs, single leg, add arm series; 'running'; feet on arches/heels/tendon stretch.

variants.difference: same motion with 1 red/blue spring: slower tempo, carriage returns less forcefully, same angles
